# Tinybird Data Processing Terms (demo mirror)

Illustrative content for the Night's Watch hackathon demo. Not Tinybird's actual terms.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

## Scope

These terms describe how Tinybird processes customer data on behalf of its customers when providing its real-time analytics database.

## Use of customer data

We process customer data only to ingest, store and query it as instructed by the customer. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention

Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination. Tax and invoice records are retained for 7 years as required by law.

## Security

Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest in European Union regions, and production access requires multi-factor authentication. We train our support staff on data protection every year.

## Changes to sub-processors

We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor. Customers may object to a new sub-processor by contacting privacy@tinybird.example.
